info.title: LinkJumkey local external-tool API
info.description: Desktop 1.8.24+. All JSON responses specify application/json; charset=utf-8. Use the Base URL displayed in Desktop settings. This API runs on the user's PC; cloud runtimes cannot reach that PC through their own 127.0.0.1. Direct writes have no import preview. Do not distribute real tokens.

get.summary: Check connectivity without reading or writing the library
List exact destination names and IDs

200.description: projects is an object array. Read object.name, never stringify the entire object.

post.summary: Save one HTTP/HTTPS button directly without a preview
post.description: Unknown names require createProject:true. Unknown IDs always fail. Matching is exact, including kana, case and whitespace. requestId deduplication lasts only while its entry remains among the most recent 256 distinct IDs; after eviction a retry is a new operation. Length limits use UTF-16 code units.

200.description: Verify button.id, button.url and project.id/name. Replays return the original button with created:false and replayed:true.

get.summary: Existing full library API; remains available

200.description: The legacy projects array contains name/buttonCount/folderCount. data retains the existing library format.

post.summary: Existing changeset API; a different contract from quick-add
post.description: Legacy createButton implicitly creates unknown string project names. Omitted/empty project uses AI作成. Explicit null/objects and other non-string values are rejected. HTTP/HTTPS only. Response uses applied[], not button. Other existing operations retain their original contracts.

200.description: Check applied[].id and project for each createButton result.

localBearer.description: Copy the local API key in Desktop Settings > MCP / AI integration > Local API. Do not use the pairing code or MCP configuration as a token.

Error.description: Branch on HTTP status and code. error/hint text is for display.

title.description: Trimmed before validation and storage. Limits use UTF-16 code units.

url.description: Complete HTTP/HTTPS URL. Credentials, backslashes, whitespace and controls are forbidden. Not trimmed.

project.description: Exact projects[].name. Existing long names are accepted; only new names are limited to 120 UTF-16 units. Reserved Object.prototype names, prototype, [object Object] and PowerShell @{...} object representations are rejected.

folderId.description: An existing folder in that project. Defaults to root. Not trimmed.

note.description: CRLF and CR are normalized to LF.

createProject.description: Explicitly create an unknown project name. Never creates an unknown projectId.

requestId.description: Same normalized payload reuses a button while this ID remains among the last 256 distinct IDs. Not trimmed. Changed payload yields REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT; a deleted/moved/modified saved target yields REQUEST_TARGET_MISSING.
